result.brief: 提出 IntactWorld 联合世界建模架构，用未压缩完整特征并在中间层预测干净特征 x0，配合 Full-to-Compact 训练范式降低显存与延迟。
result.reason: Proposes joint world modeling architecture with uncompressed intact features and clean-feature x0 prediction in latent space, directly addressing world-model representation and generative latent design.
